comments.body:
RCA (rebar-debug Phase 1 complete; runtime-proven with a stub-driven replay, no live model involved).

PROVEN ROOT CAUSE - stale oracle unit after a deliberate contract re-denomination (unmet consumer update), not a banking-mechanism regression and not a Bedrock model shift.

Mechanism: commit e1352535ace 'Recover evidence lost to a batched governed read' (ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86 / rutile-massive-spoonbill, merged Aug 12) changed src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py from acted_steps (at most ONE governed action executed per model response; extra batched calls returned COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE unexecuted) to per-KIND claims (step_kind dict): additional EVIDENCE calls in an evidence-claimed run_step now execute normally. That was correct and deliberate (dd41's own RCA proved the old suppression banked FALSE met=false 4/4 against files that exist). But it decoupled the two units the 0707 oracle silently equated: the policy's finite boundary counts evidence RESPONSES (current_evidence_steps is a set of run_steps; max_evidence_responses=3), while _bounded_bank_gaps in tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py measures EXECUTED filesystem-tool calls. Pre-dd41 those were numerically coupled (extras suppressed => ~1 executed call per response). Post-dd41 a batching model (Sonnet 4.6 at temp 0 batches heavily) executes ~11 reads in <=2 evidence-claimed responses, never reaches the 3-response fallback boundary, records all 5 verdicts at the end, and every first bank lands at executed-call counter 11 => calls_at_bank=[11,11,11,11,11], banked=5, PASS, error=None - exactly the failure, and exactly the natural pre-enforcement signature ticket 0707 itself recorded for this fixture.

DISCRIMINATING EXPERIMENTS (local stub replay driving wrap_completion_evidence_policy with a fake toolset + fake run_steps, mirroring the live counting/observer seams):
- E1: transcript = step1 batch of 6 reads, step2 batch of 5, then 5 record-only steps. CURRENT policy: 11/11 reads execute, zero fallbacks, calls_at_bank=[11,11,11,11,11], oracle bounded=False - byte-identical to CI. PRE-dd41 policy (e1352535ace^), SAME transcript: 2 executed + 9 steered, calls_at_bank=[2,2,2,2,2], bounded=True. The good->bad flip reproduces from the policy diff alone with zero model involvement => kills 'Bedrock model shift' and 'verifier loop regression'.
- E1b: 4+4+3 reads, no records: current policy DOES fire the 3-response fallback (c1 met=false) but at executed counter 9 => even a fired boundary cannot satisfy a gap<=3 bound in executed-call units; the oracle is structurally unsatisfiable post-dd41 for a batching model, not marginally miscalibrated.
- E2: tests/_bank_observer.make_observed_upsert audited directly: records the counter AT each first tool write (writes=[c1,c2], at=[4,11] for a mutating counter), revisions and non-tool sources ignored => measurement-bug rival dead. (e558bd1249b, the observer kwarg-forwarding change, merged AFTER the first red run - not causal.)
- E3 (latent-risk probe): truncating E1 after step2 (simulated exhaustion before any record) leaves the bank EMPTY under the current policy at 11 executed calls. Mitigations: the budget is request-denominated (batching consumes FEWER requests, dd41 measured run steps 9.5->7.0), and the per-criterion 3-evidence-response fallback still bounds a persistent searcher. Residual: dd41 also removed the steering notice that nudged interleaved COMMITs; nothing now encourages (only the fallback forces) incremental banking. Noted as residual risk, not this bug.

TIMELINE / DETERMINISM: test green on the bedrock arm Aug 10 (run 31362329118) and Aug 12 10:26 UTC (31587452003, sha b13173bb7db); e1352535ace authored Aug 12 11:01 UTC; first red Aug 14 14:05 UTC (31807853902, sha 9a7a1cad4a5) and every run since, always [11,11,11,11,11]. Deterministic (3/3 per run at temperature 0), confirmed non-flaky. The anthropic arm SKIPPED this module (it is pinned to provider bedrock via skip_unless_provider; its log shows 3 skipped) - the anthropic pass discriminates nothing.

DEFECT LEGITIMACY: the production behavior (batched governed reads execute; boundary denominated in responses) is INTENDED - authority: dd41-239d-6e09-4a86, Gerrit-reviewed commit e1352535ace with its own proven RCA (<6 months, deliberate). The defective artifact is the TEST: _bounded_bank_gaps asserts the pre-dd41 mechanism's incidental unit (executed calls), i.e. the 0707 contract line 'at most three real repository executions' encoded the suppression side effect, not the safety intent. The 0707 safety intent (incremental banking bounded so progress survives a bounded run; no zero-bank exhaustion) still holds post-dd41 in the budget's actual unit: at most 3 evidence RESPONSES per current criterion before a fail-closed bank. Repair = re-denominate the oracle/measurement to evidence responses (unit-coupled to the enforcement), per this ticket's own AC ('if the oracle is wrong, the test is corrected under the strict test-modification order'). Reverting dd41 instead would reinstate proven false met=false verdicts.

CAUSED_BY ATTRIBUTION (unmet obligation / missed consumer update): the oracle lines predate the good->bad transition (date test: test authored Aug 9, transition Aug 12-14), so the site of failure is not the origin. The change that created the new contract and shipped without updating its consumer is e1352535ace, ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86. Sanity check: dd41's review touched the very docstring that declares 'the finite boundary below counts responses' and its commit message names the response-vs-call distinction - a reviewer could plausibly have flagged the executed-call-denominated live oracle guarding that seam. Close will carry --class=regression --caused-by=dd41-239d-6e09-4a86.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Live External Integration run 32568560934 (bedrock arm) fails
`tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:183`
`test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials` 0/3 trials, deterministically
(temperature 0, 3/3 identical), every trial `{"banked": 5, "verdict": "PASS", "error": None,
"calls_at_bank": [11,11,11,11,11], "evidence_calls": 11}`. Root cause is PROVEN (see RCA comment):
commit `e1352535ace` (ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86, Gerrit-reviewed, deliberate) changed
`src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py` so additional batched EVIDENCE calls in an
evidence-claimed model response execute instead of being suppressed with a steering notice. That
was correct (the suppression banked provably false `met=false` verdicts), but it decoupled the two
units this test's oracle silently equated: the enforcement boundary is denominated in evidence
RESPONSES (`current_evidence_steps` is a set of run_steps, `max_evidence_responses=3` at
`src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py:111`), while the oracle `_bounded_bank_gaps`
(`tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:118`) bounds gaps in EXECUTED
filesystem-tool calls (counter at `tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:65`).
A batching model executes ~11 reads in <=2 evidence responses, so the executed-call bound is
structurally unsatisfiable post-dd41 (stub replay E1b showed even a fired 3-response fallback
lands at executed counter 9). The production behavior is intended; the TEST is the defective
artifact (a stale, over-specified oracle unit). The banking contract itself is unchanged: at most
3 evidence responses per current criterion before a fail-closed bank.

## Approach

Test-only repair: re-denominate the live oracle's measurement and bound to the unit the
enforcement is denominated in — evidence responses — instead of the pre-dd41 incidental unit of
executed calls. This preserves the 0707 safety intent (incremental banking with bounded gaps, no
zero-bank exhaustion: a trial with zero banks or with a first bank after >3 evidence responses
still FAILS) while accepting the dd41-intended batched execution. No production code changes;
reverting dd41 instead would reinstate its proven false-verdict defect, so it is not an option.

Measurement seam (confirmed by reading the tree): `src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:312` imports
`wrap_completion_evidence_policy` function-locally at call time from
`rebar.llm.completion_tool_policy`, so a monkeypatch on that module attribute is picked up per
run. The trial harness will patch it with a wrapper that calls the original and then wraps the
returned toolsets in an outer counting toolset which records the distinct `ctx.run_step` values
at which a governed evidence tool (`read_file`/`list_directory`/`search_files`) actually executed
(a result equal to `COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE`/`ALL_CRITERIA_BANKED_NOTICE`,
`src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py:46`/`:51`, means steered-not-executed and is not
counted). The existing `make_observed_upsert` observer (`tests/_bank_observer.py`) then snapshots
the evidence-RESPONSE count at each criterion's first tool write; `_bounded_bank_gaps` keeps its
exact shape (points, pairwise gaps, all gaps <= 3) over response-denominated points, matching
`max_evidence_responses=3`. The raw executed-call counter stays in the trial dict as a
diagnostic only. The shared counting toolset and the gap oracle move into `tests/_bank_observer.py`
so the live eval and a new live-independent unit regression exercise one implementation (the
factoring pattern that module's docstring already prescribes).

## Scope

- `tests/_bank_observer.py` — add the response-counting wrapper-toolset factory and the
  response-denominated bounded-gap oracle helper alongside `make_observed_upsert`.
- `tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py` — patch
  `completion_tool_policy.wrap_completion_evidence_policy` in `_observe_trial` to install the
  counting toolset; record `responses_at_bank` (response units) for the oracle; keep
  `evidence_calls` as diagnostic; update `_bounded_bank_gaps` to consume the response-denominated
  points; update the module docstring to name the post-dd41 unit.
- `tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py` (new) — live-independent regression driving the
  shared helpers over stub transcripts through the REAL `wrap_completion_evidence_policy`:
  (1) intended post-dd41 shape (two batched evidence responses then five records) is ACCEPTED;
  (2) the original 0707 defect shapes are REJECTED — zero banks at exhaustion, and a first bank
  only after >3 evidence responses; (3) steered calls are not counted as responses.

## Testing

Happy path: the unit regression's accepted-shape case (batched execution, all criteria banked,
gaps <= 3 responses) passes against the real policy wrapper. Failure/edge paths: the unit
regression's rejected shapes (zero-bank exhaustion; unbounded first bank at >3 evidence
responses; steering notices not counted) all FAIL the oracle — this is the RED-preserving teeth
check required by the strict test-modification order, run with no production change present. The
live eval itself is bedrock-pinned and cannot run locally; final GREEN is confirmed by a
post-merge `workflow_dispatch` of external-integration.yml (the same trigger as the failing run).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `_bounded_bank_gaps` and the trial measurement are denominated in evidence responses
  (distinct executed-evidence run_steps), verified by reading the revised test and by the unit
  regression passing via `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py -q`.
- [ ] The revised oracle still REJECTS the original 0707 defect shapes (zero banks; first bank
  after more than 3 evidence responses), asserted by dedicated unit cases run with no production
  code modified.
- [ ] The revised oracle ACCEPTS the dd41-intended batched shape that currently fails
  ([11,11,11,11,11] executed-call signature collapsing to <=3 evidence responses), asserted by a
  unit case replaying that exact transcript.
- [ ] No files outside the three declared test paths change (`git diff --stat` on the change
  shows only those paths).
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`
  pass in the worktree venv.
- [ ] After merge, a dispatched Live External Integration run shows
  `test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials` PASSED on the bedrock arm.
